10.title: 10. Ekologik Jarima & Matematik Hisob-kitob
10.desc: Atmosferaga me'yordan ortiq chiqarilgan SO2 va chang uchun oshirilgan jarimani hisoblang.

scenarios.title: SO2 Bo'yicha Me'yordan Ortiq Tashlama Hisobi
scenarios.param: Yillik limit: 50 tonna | Haqiqiy tashlama: 62 tonna | Ortiqcha: 12 tonna
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="60" y="45" width="200" height="30" fill="#047857"/><text x="160" y="65" fill="white" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">50t Ruxsat Etilgan Limit</text><rect x="260" y="45" width="100" height="30" fill="#ef4444"/><text x="310" y="65" fill="white" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">+12t Ortiqcha!</text><text x="250" y="105" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Jarima Formulada 5 barobar oshirilgan koeffitsiyent bilan hisoblanadi</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Zavod ruxsat etilgan limitdan 12 tonna ortiq SO2 chiqardi. Kompensatsiya to'lovi qanday hisoblanadi?
options: 12 tonna ortiqcha tashlama uchun qonunchilik bo'yicha 5 barobar oshirilgan stavka qo'llanilib jarima solinadi
Oddiy 1 barobar stavka to'lanadi
Limit oshishi tabiatga zarar bermaydi deb bekor qilinadi
scenarios.hint: O'zR qonunchiligiga ko'ra me'yordan ortiq (sverxlimit) tashlamalar uchun oshirilgan 5x karrali koeffitsiyent qo'llaniladi.

scenarios.title: 1-Xavflilik Sinfiga Mansub Zaharli Chiqindilar
scenarios.param: Xavflilik sinfi: 1 (O'ta xavfli) | Massa: 500 kg simobli lampalar
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="180" y="30" width="140" height="70" rx="8" fill="#7f1d1d" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1-Sinf Xavfli</text><text x="250" y="75" fill="#ffffff" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Simob / Polixlorbifenil</text><text x="250" y="90" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">K_xavf = 10.0 Maksimal</text></svg>
scenarios.question: 1-sinf xavfli chiqindilar noqonuniy tashlab ketilganda xavflilik koeffitsiyenti (K_xavf) qanday qabul qilinadi?
options: Eng yuqori maksimal koeffitsiyent (10.0) qo'llanilib, atrof-muhitga yetkazilgan zarar hisoblanadi
Oddiy maishiy chiqindi kabi 1.0 deb olinadi
Koeffitsiyent nolga tenglashtiriladi
scenarios.hint: 1-sinf chiqindilar tabiatni o'nlab yillarga zaharlaydi, shuning uchun jarima multiplikatori eng yuqori bo'ladi.

scenarios.title: Oqova Suvda Neft Mahsulotlari Ko'payishi
scenarios.param: PDS me'yori: 0.05 mg/l | Oqovada: 2.5 mg/l (50 barobar oshish!)
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="80" y="45" width="140" height="35" rx="6" fill="#047857"/><text x="150" y="67" fill="white" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">PDS: 0.05 mg/l</text><text x="250" y="68" fill="#ef4444" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">→</text><rect x="280" y="45" width="150" height="35" rx="6" fill="#7f1d1d" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2"/><text x="355" y="67" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Haqiqiy: 2.5 mg/l (50x)</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Avtomobil yuvish shoxobchasi daryoga me'yordan 50 barobar ko'p neftli suv oqizdi. Qanday chora ko'riladi?
options: Zarar yetkazilgan suv hajmi bo'yicha yirik jarima solinadi va tozalash inshooti qurilmaguncha faoliyati to'xtatiladi
Faqat ogohlantirish xati berilib suv oqizishga ruxsat beriladi
Shoxobchaga mukofot beriladi
scenarios.hint: Suv havzalariga neft oqizish qat'iy javobgarlikka sabab bo'lib, korxona faoliyati to'xtatilishi shart.

scenarios.title: Suv Havzasi Qirg'oq Himoya Zonasidagi Jarima
scenarios.param: Hududiy koeffitsiyent: Qirg'oq himoya zonasida K_hudud = 3.0
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="180" y="30" width="140" height="70" rx="8" fill="#1e3a8a" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Daryo Himoya Zonasi</text><text x="250" y="75" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">K_hudud = 3.0</text><text x="250" y="90" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Jarima 3 barobarga oshadi</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Chiqindini daryoning qirg'oq himoya polosasiga noqonuniy to'kish oddiy joyga nisbatan qanday hisoblanadi?
options: Maxsus himoyalangan hudud bo'lganligi uchun hududiy koeffitsiyent 3 barobar oshiriladi
Hech qanday farqi yo'q, hamma joyga bir xil hisoblanadi
Daryo yaqin bo'lgani uchun jarima kamaytiriladi
scenarios.hint: Suvni muhofaza qilish polosalari ekologik o'ta nozik hudud hisoblanib, qat'iy koeffitsiyentlar qo'llaniladi.

scenarios.title: Filtrni O'chirib Qo'yish (24 Soatlik Avariya)
scenarios.param: 24 soat x 500 kg/soat tozalanmagan chang = 12 000 kg
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="120" y="35" width="260" height="60" rx="8" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="60" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Filtr 24 soat o'chiq turgan!</text><text x="250" y="80" fill="#ffffff" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">12 tonna xom zaharli chang atmosferada</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Zavod elektrni tejash uchun filtrni 24 soat o'chirib qo'yganini inspeksiya fosh qildi. To'lov qanday hisoblanadi?
options: Filtrsiz ishlagan barcha soatlar uchun maksimal quvvat bo'yicha to'liq tashlama hisoblanib, 10 barobar jarima undiriladi
Faqat o'chirilgan paytda ko'rinib qolgan bir necha minut hisoblanadi
Kechirim berilib elektr tejalgani maqtovga sazovor deb topiladi
scenarios.hint: Gaz tozalash uskunalarini qasddan o'chirib qo'yish ekologik qoidabuzarlikning eng og'ir turidir.

scenarios.title: PM2.5 Chang Zarralari Bo'yicha Jarima
scenarios.param: PM2.5 konsentratsiyasi: Ruxsat 0.06 mg/m3 | Haqiqiy 0.85 mg/m3
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="180" y="30" width="140" height="70" rx="8" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PM2.5 Mayda Chang</text><text x="250" y="75" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">14 barobar ortiqcha</text><text x="250" y="90" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">O'pka va qonga singuvchi</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Aholi yashash massivi yaqinida PM2.5 me'yordan 14 barobar oshganda jarima qanday asoslanadi?
options: Aholi salomatligiga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri xavf tug'diruvchi yuqori zaharli kantselyar omil sifatida eng yuqori toifa bo'yicha
Oddiy chang kabi e'tiborsiz qoldiriladi
Shamolda uchib ketgani uchun jarima yozilmaydi
scenarios.hint: PM2.5 zarralari inson o'pkasining chuqur alveolalariga kirib qonga o'tuvchi eng xavfli chang turidir.

scenarios.title: Aralash Xavfli Chiqindilar Saqlash
scenarios.param: Akkumulyator kislotasi va qog'oz chiqindilari aralashtirilgan
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="180" y="30" width="140" height="70" rx="8" fill="#7f1d1d" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Aralash Saqlash ⚠️</text><text x="250" y="75" fill="#ffffff" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Yong'in va Toksik Xavf</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Korxona xavfli akkumulyator kislotali qoldiqlarini oddiy maishiy chiqindi bilan aralashtirib saqlagan. Jarima qanday qo'llanadi?
options: Barcha aralashgan hajm eng yuqori xavfli toifa deb baholanadi va qat'iy moddiy jarima belgilanadi
Faqat kislota qismi alohida hisoblanadi
Chiqindilar aralashsa arzonlashadi deb to'lov olinmaydi
scenarios.hint: Sanitariya qoidalariga ko'ra xavfsiz chiqindi xavfli chiqindiga tekkanda, butun massa xavfli deb tan olinadi.

scenarios.title: Ko'p Yillik Qimmatbaho Daraxtlarni Shikastlash
scenarios.param: Diametri 60 sm bo'lgan chinor daraxti noqonuniy kesilgan
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><circle cx="250" cy="50" r="22" fill="#047857"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="white" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">🌳</text><text x="250" y="90" fill="#f87171" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">BHM ning 100-300 barobari + 100 ta ko'chat ekish majburiyati</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Qurilish kompaniyasi 80 yillik chinor daraxtini noqonuniy kesib tashladi. Qanday ekologik chora qo'llanadi?
options: Yetkazilgan zarar to'liq undiriladi, eng yuqori jarima solinadi va o'rniga 100 tup 5 yillik ko'chat ekib 3 yil parvarishlash majburiyati yuklanadi
Faqat o'tin puli to'lanadi
Kompaniyaga hech narsa qilinmaydi
scenarios.hint: O'zbekistonda daraxtlarni kesishga moratoriy amal qilmoqda va har bir noqonuniy kesilgan daraxt uchun ulkan jarimalar belgilangan.

scenarios.title: Ixtiyoriy 30 Kunlik To'lov Imtiyozi
scenarios.param: Jarima dalolatnomasi topshirildi: 30 kun ichida to'lov
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="150" y="35" width="200" height="60" rx="8" fill="#065f46" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="60" fill="#34d399" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">30 Kun Ichida To'lov</text><text x="250" y="80" fill="#a7f3d0" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">70% to'lansa, 30% chegirma (Rag'bat)</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Huquqbuzar jarimani o'z ixtiyori bilan 30 kun ichida to'lasa qanday qonuniy rag'bat bor?
options: Belgilangan jarima summasining 70% ini 30 kun ichida ixtiyoriy to'lasa, qolgan 30% idan ozod qilinadi
Hech qanday imtiyoz berilmaydi
Jarima summasi ikki barobar oshiriladi
scenarios.hint: Ixtiyoriy to'lov tizimi da'vo jarayonlarini tezlashtiradi va kompensatsiyaning darhol ekologik jamg'armaga tushishini ta'minlaydi.

scenarios.title: Issiqxona Gazlari Metan (CO2-ekvivalent) Balansi
scenarios.param: CH4 ning issiqxona salohiyati: GWP = 28 barobar CO2 dan kuchli
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="80" y="45" width="140" height="40" rx="6" fill="#1e293b"/><text x="150" y="70" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle">1 Tonna CH4 (Metan)</text><text x="250" y="70" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">=</text><rect x="280" y="45" width="150" height="40" rx="6" fill="#7f1d1d" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2"/><text x="355" y="70" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">28 Tonna CO2-ekv!</text></svg>
scenarios.question: 1 tonna metan havoga chiqib ketsa, Parij bitimi bo'yicha qancha CO2 ga teng zarar yetkaziladi?
options: 28 tonna CO2 ekvivalentiga teng, chunki metan issiqlikni 28 barobar kuchli ushlab turadi
Aynan 1 tonna CO2 ga teng
Metan issiqxona gazi emas, zararsiz
scenarios.hint: Metan qisqa muddatda atmosferani eng tez isituvchi agressiv gaz bo'lib, uning emissiyasi qat'iy hisoblanadi.

11.title: 11. Yashil Shahar Arxitekturasi
11.desc: Shamol atirguli (roza vetrov) va 1000m sanitar zonani hisobga olib shaharni to'g'ri loyihalang.

scenarios.title: Shamol Atirguli (Roza Vetrov) Tahlili
scenarios.param: Ustun shamol yo'nalishi: Shimoli-Sharq (NE) → Janubi-G'arb (SW)
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><circle cx="150" cy="65" r="45" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#818cf8" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="150" y1="20" x2="150" y2="110" stroke="#64748b"/><line x1="105" y1="65" x2="195" y2="65" stroke="#64748b"/><path d="M 180 35 L 120 95" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="4"/><text x="185" y="30" fill="#f87171" font-size="10" font-weight="bold">NE Shamol</text><rect x="300" y="35" width="140" height="60" rx="8" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="370" y="60" fill="#34d399" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Sanoat Zonasi:</text><text x="370" y="78" fill="white" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Janubi-G'arbga joylanadi</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Shamol yil bo'yi shimoli-sharqdan essachi, kimyo sanoat hududi shahar aholisiga nisbatan qayerda joylashishi kerak?
options: Shahar aholisi shamolning yuqori (shimoli-sharqiy) qismida, zavodlar esa shamol yo'nalishi bo'yicha pastda (janubi-g'arbda) joylashishi shart
Zavodlarni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri shamol kelayotgan shimoli-sharqqa aholi oldiga qurish
Zavodlarni shahar markaziga joylashtirish
scenarios.hint: Zavodlar doimo shamol osti (podvetrennaya storona) tomonda joylashtirilsa, tutun shaharga emas, dashtga qarab ketadi.

scenarios.title: Sanitar-Himoya Zonasi (SPZ = 1000m)
scenarios.param: 1-sinf metallurgiya kombinati va aholi uylari orasi
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="50" y="35" width="100" height="60" rx="8" fill="#7f1d1d"/><text x="100" y="70" fill="white" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Metallurgiya</text><line x1="160" y1="65" x2="340" y2="65" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="6,4"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#34d399" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1000 metr Yashil SPZ Zonasi</text><rect x="350" y="35" width="100" height="60" rx="8" fill="#047857"/><text x="400" y="70" fill="white" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Aholi Massivi</text></svg>
scenarios.question: 1-toifali og'ir sanoat korxonasi va aholi turar-joyi o'rtasidagi minimal Sanitar-himoya zonasi qancha bo'lishi shart?
options: Kamida 1000 metr yashil daraxtzorlar bilan qoplangan himoya polisasi
50 metr yetarli
Orasida masofa bo'lishi shart emas
scenarios.hint: SanQvaM 0350-17 bo'yicha 1-sinf xavfli obyektlar uchun 1000 metr masofa qat'iy qonuniy talabdir.

scenarios.title: Shahar Shamollatish Koridorlari (Aero-Ventilyatsiya)
scenarios.param: Ko'p qavatli binolar shamol oqimini to'sib qo'ymasligi lozim
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="80" y="30" width="30" height="70" fill="#334155"/><rect x="150" y="30" width="30" height="70" fill="#334155"/><rect x="220" y="30" width="30" height="70" fill="#334155"/><path d="M 50 65 L 450 65" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="4"/><text x="350" y="60" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="11" font-weight="bold">Keng Xiyobonli Havo Koridori</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Smog va havoning turg'unlashib qolishini oldini olish uchun zamonaviy shaharlar qanday loyihalanadi?
options: Shamol yo'nalishi bo'ylab keng yashil xiyobonlar va daryo bo'ylari bo'ylab ochiq 'havo koridorlari' qoldiriladi
Shamol yo'liga 30 qavatli uylarni uzluksiz devor qilib quriladi
Shaharni yopiq gumbaz bilan o'rab olinadi
scenarios.hint: Havo koridorlari tog'dan keluvchi toza shabadani shahar markazigacha yetkazib, avtomobil tutunlarini haydab chiqaradi.

scenarios.title: Magistral Yo'l Shovqiniga Qarshi Yashil To'siq
scenarios.param: Magistral: 85 dBA shovqin | Maktab binosi yaqin
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="50" y="45" width="100" height="40" fill="#334155"/><text x="100" y="70" fill="white" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Magistral (85 dB)</text><circle cx="210" cy="65" r="16" fill="#15803d"/><circle cx="250" cy="65" r="20" fill="#166534"/><circle cx="290" cy="65" r="16" fill="#15803d"/><text x="250" y="110" fill="#34d399" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">3 Qator Daraxt + Akustik Ekran (-20 dB)</text><rect x="360" y="45" width="90" height="40" fill="#0369a1"/><text x="405" y="70" fill="white" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Maktab</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Katta trassa yonidagi maktab bolalarini shovqin va zaharli gazdan qanday samarali himoya qilinadi?
options: Akustik shaffof himoya devori va 3 qatorli zich bargli butalar hamda ignabargli daraxtlar belbog'i bilan
Yo'l chetiga reklama bannerlari ilib qo'yish bilan
Maktab derazalarini g'isht bilan terib yopish bilan
scenarios.hint: Ko'p qatlamli yashil to'siq shovqinni 15-20 dBA ga kamaytiradi va og'ir metall changlarini 70% barglarida tutib qoladi.

scenarios.title: Shahar Issiqlik Oroli (Urban Heat Island) Effekti
scenarios.param: Asfalt va beton harorati: 52°C | Yashil parkda: 31°C
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="80" y="35" width="140" height="60" rx="6" fill="#7f1d1d"/><text x="150" y="60" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Beton Markaz (52°C)</text><text x="150" y="80" fill="white" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Konditsionerlar zo'riqishi</text><text x="250" y="70" fill="#10b981" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">→</text><rect x="280" y="35" width="150" height="60" rx="6" fill="#065f46" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="355" y="60" fill="#34d399" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yashil Tom & Park (31°C)</text><text x="355" y="80" fill="#a7f3d0" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Tabiiy sovutish</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Yozda shahar ichi jazirama issiq bo'lib ketmasligi uchun shaharsozlar nima qilishi kerak?
options: Binolarda yashil tomlar (Green roofs), ochiq suv havzalari, favvoralar va soyali xiyobonlar ulushini kamida 40% ga yetkazish
Butun shaharni asfalt bilan qoplash
Ko'chalarga ko'proq yirik konditsionerlar o'rnatish
scenarios.hint: Daraxtlar transpiratsiya (suv bug'latish) hisobiga havo haroratini sun'iy asfaltdan 8-12 darajagacha pasaytiradi.

scenarios.title: Bio-Drenaj Ariqlari va Yomg'ir Bog'lari (Rain Gardens)
scenarios.param: Yomg'ir suvi kollektorga toshmasdan yer ostiga singishi kerak
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><path d="M 120 40 L 160 90 L 340 90 L 380 40 Z" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="65" fill="#34d399" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yomg'ir Bog'i (Bioswale)</text><text x="250" y="82" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">G'ovakli qatlam + Suv o'simliklari</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Shahar ko'chalarida yomg'ir yoqqanda suv toshib ketmasligi uchun qanday yashil infratuzilma qo'llaniladi?
options: G'ovakli shag'al va o'simliklardan iborat yomg'ir bog'lari (Rain gardens) orqali suvni tabiiy tozalab yerosti suviga singdirish
Barcha ariqlarni betonlab yopib tashlash
Yomg'ir suvini chelaklarda tashish
scenarios.hint: Yomg'ir bog'lari shahar drenaj tizimi yuklamasini 60% ga yengillatadi va yerosti suv zaxiralarini to'ldiradi.

scenarios.title: Chiqindi Maydonchasi Masofasi (SanQvaM)
scenarios.param: Norma: Turar-joy binosidan minimal 20m, maksimal 100m
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="60" y="40" width="80" height="50" fill="#334155"/><text x="100" y="70" fill="white" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Uy Derazasi</text><line x1="150" y1="65" x2="330" y2="65" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="3"/><text x="240" y="55" fill="#34d399" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">20 m ≤ Masofa ≤ 100 m</text><rect x="340" y="40" width="100" height="50" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="390" y="68" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Konteyner</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Chiqindi yig'ish maydonchasi ko'p qavatli turar-joy derazasidan necha metr uzoqlikda joylashishi kerak?
options: Kamida 20 metr (hid va hasharot kirmasligi uchun) va ko'pi bilan 100 metr (aholi borishi oson bo'lishi uchun)
To'g'ridan-to'g'ri podyezd eshigi tagiga 1 metr qilib qo'yish
Shahardan 5 km tashqariga qo'yish
scenarios.hint: SanQvaM 0300-14 bo'yicha 20-100 metr oralig'i sanitariya xavfsizligi va qulaylikning oltin qoidasidir.

scenarios.title: Sanoat Oqovalarini Daryoga Ulash Taqiqlanishi
scenarios.param: Kimyo korxonasi oqovasi: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri daryoga ulash man etiladi
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="70" y="35" width="120" height="60" rx="6" fill="#7f1d1d"/><text x="130" y="65" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Zavod Oqovasi</text><line x1="200" y1="65" x2="300" y2="65" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="6"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#ef4444" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">✕</text><rect x="310" y="35" width="130" height="60" rx="6" fill="#0284c7"/><text x="375" y="65" fill="white" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Tabiiy Daryo</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Sanoat zonasini loyihalashda korxona oqova suvlarini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri daryoga ulash mumkinmi?
options: Mutlaqo yo'q! Zavod o'zining lokal tozalash inshootiga ega bo'lishi va faqat chuqur tozalangach shahar kollektoriga ruxsat etiladi
Ha, daryo oqimi katta bo'lsa darhol suyulib ketadi
Faqat kechasi oqizish sharti bilan ruxsat beriladi
scenarios.hint: Tozalanmagan sanoat oqovalarini ochiq suv havzasiga chiqarish qat'iyan jinoiy javobgarlikka olib keladi.

scenarios.title: Yashil Transport va Velosiped Magistrallari
scenarios.param: Transport chiqindilari shahar havosi ifloslanishining 60% qismi
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="80" y="45" width="140" height="40" rx="8" fill="#1e293b"/><text x="150" y="70" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Avtomobil Yo'li</text><rect x="230" y="40" width="15" height="50" fill="#047857"/><text x="237" y="30" fill="#34d399" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Yashil To'siq</text><rect x="255" y="45" width="160" height="40" rx="8" fill="#065f46" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="335" y="70" fill="#a7f3d0" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Alohida Velo-Magistral 🚲</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Shaharda avtomobilsiz sog'lom harakatni rivojlantirish uchun veloyo'laklar qanday quriladi?
options: Avtomobil harakatidan yashil daraxtzor yoki bort bilan to'liq ajratilgan, xavfsiz va uzluksiz tarmoq sifatida
Mashinalar orasidan chiziq chizib qo'yish bilan
Piyodalar yo'lkasida odamlar orasidan yurgizish bilan
scenarios.hint: Izolyatsiyalangan velomagistrallar xavfsizlikni 90% oshiradi va aholini velosipeddan kundalik foydalanishga undaydi.

scenarios.title: Quyosh Panellari va Energo-Samarador Binolar
scenarios.param: Orientatsiya: Janubiy tomon (180°) | Nishablik: 32°
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><path d="M 120 90 L 250 30 L 380 90 Z" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="340" cy="40" r="14" fill="#f59e0b"/><text x="250" y="65" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Janubga Qaragan Quyosh Tomi</text><text x="250" y="85" fill="#34d399" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Nishablik 32° (Maksimal insolyatsiya)</text></svg>
scenarios.question: O'zbekiston sharoitida quyosh panellari eng ko'p energiya ishlab chiqarishi uchun binolar qaysi tomonga qarashi kerak?
options: Uylarning asosiy tomlari janubga tomon 30-35° burchak ostida yo'naltirilgan bo'lishi kerak
Shimol tomonga qaratilishi kerak
Quyoshdan panalab daraxtlar soyasiga yashirilishi kerak
scenarios.hint: O'zbekiston shimoliy yarimsharda joylashgani uchun janubiy orientatsiya yil bo'yi maksimal quyosh nuri oladi.

12.title: 12. Ekologik Detektiv: GIS & Sun'iy Yo'ldosh
12.desc: Sun'iy yo'ldosh xaritasi va spektral datchiklar orqali ko'milgan noqonuniy chiqindilarni toping.

scenarios.title: Termal Infraqizil (TIR) Issiqlik Anomaliyasi
scenarios.param: Sentinel-2 / Landsat-8 termal kanali (B10) | Harorat: +12°C yuqori
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><circle cx="250" cy="65" r="40" fill="#7f1d1d" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="3"/><text x="250" y="60" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Issiqlik Anomaliyasi!</text><text x="250" y="78" fill="white" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">+12°C Atrofga nisbatan</text><text x="250" y="115" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Yer ostida noqonuniy chiriyotgan organik chiqindi</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Tunda olingan sun'iy yo'ldosh termal xaritasida adirlik ostida kutilmaganda +12°C issiqlik o'chog'i ko'rindi. Bu nima?
options: Tuproq ostiga noqonuniy ko'milgan chiqindilar chirishi natijasida metan va biologik issiqlik ajralmoqda
Yer ostida vulqon paydo bo'lgan
Oddiy qum qatlami
scenarios.hint: Chiriyotgan organik massalar termofil bakteriyalar tufayli 50-60°C gacha qiziydi va termal sun'iy yo'ldoshda yaqqol fosh bo'ladi.

scenarios.title: Vegetatsiya Indeksi (NDVI) Keskin Tushishi
scenarios.param: NDVI normasi: 0.75 (Sog'lom yashil) | Anomaliya zonasi: 0.18
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="60" y="40" width="120" height="50" rx="6" fill="#047857"/><text x="120" y="65" fill="white" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">NDVI = 0.75 (Yashil)</text><text x="240" y="70" fill="#ef4444" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">→</text><rect x="270" y="40" width="160" height="50" rx="6" fill="#7f1d1d" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2"/><text x="350" y="62" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">NDVI = 0.18 (Qurigan)</text><text x="350" y="78" fill="white" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Zaharli sizib chiqish o'chog'i</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Ekin maydoni o'rtasida 200 metrli doira ichida o'simliklar keskin sarg'ayib quriydi (NDVI tushgan). Sababi:
options: Yerosti suviga yaqin ko'milgan zaharli kimyoviy shlam o'simlik ildiz tizimini zaharlagan
O'simliklar quyoshdan uyalib qolgan
U yerga faqat oq gul ekilgan
scenarios.hint: NDVI spektral indeksi o'simlikdagi xlorofill miqdorini o'lchaydi; zaharli ifloslanishda xlorofill birinchi bo'lib parchalanadi.

scenarios.title: Qisqa To'lqinli Infraqizil (SWIR) Spektroskopiya
scenarios.param: Spektral belgi: Polimer va uglevodorodlarning yutilish chizig'i
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><path d="M 80 80 Q 150 20 220 80 T 360 80" fill="none" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="220" cy="80" r="6" fill="#ef4444"/><text x="220" y="105" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Plastik Absorbtsiya Pik (2.2 µm)</text><text x="250" y="35" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Ko'milgan Plastik Chiqindixona Fosh Etildi</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Tuproq bilan yupqa ko'mib yashirilgan plastmassa va polimer chiqindilarini kosmosdan qanday aniqlanadi?
options: SWIR (Qisqa to'lqinli infraqizil) kanalida polimerlarning o'ziga xos 2.2 mkm spektral yutilish chizig'i orqali
Kosmonavtlar durbin bilan qarab topadi
Tuproqni qazib ko'rmaguncha aniqlashning iloji yo'q
scenarios.hint: Har bir kimyoviy modda o'ziga xos spektral barmoq iziga (spectral signature) ega bo'lib, sun'iy yo'ldoshda aniq ko'rinadi.

scenarios.title: SAR Radari: Poligon Cho'kishi va Deformatsiyasi
scenarios.param: Interferometrik SAR (InSAR) | Yillik siljish: -18 mm
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><path d="M 120 70 L 250 90 L 380 70" fill="none" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="6,4"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">InSAR: Cho'kish -18 mm/yil</text><text x="250" y="115" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Geomembrana uzilish va o'pirilish xavfi bor</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Sun'iy yo'ldosh radari poligon qiyaliklarida yiliga 18 millimetr siljishni ko'rsatdi. Bu qanday xavf?
options: Poligon ichki qatlamlarida ko'chki va geomembrana yirtilish xavfi bor; zudlik bilan mustahkamlash talab etiladi
Hech qanday xavf yo'q, yer har doim qimirlab turadi
Poligon o'z-o'zidan tekislanib qolishini kutish kerak
scenarios.hint: Radar interferometriyasi (InSAR) millimetrlik aniqlikda poligon dambalari cho'kishini oldindan ogohlantiradi.

scenarios.title: Daryoga Tunda Oqizilgan Loyqalanish (Turbidity)
scenarios.param: Spektral loyqalik izi (Turbidity plume): Zavod trubasidan 8 km ga cho'zilgan
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><path d="M 50 65 Q 250 40 450 65" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="16"/><path d="M 160 65 Q 280 50 400 65" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="10"/><circle cx="150" cy="65" r="10" fill="#ef4444"/><text x="150" y="45" fill="#f87171" font-size="10" font-weight="bold">Noqonuniy Truba</text><text x="320" y="95" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="10" font-weight="bold">8 km ga cho'zilgan loyqa shlam oqimi</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Zavod tunda daryoga kirlangan oqova tashladi. Detektiv inspektor buni qanday fosh etadi?
options: Ertalabki sun'iy yo'ldosh suratida suvning spektral aks etish koeffitsiyenti (loyqalik oqimi) orqali manbani aniq trubasigacha topadi
Buni fosh etishning imkoni yo'q, suv oqib ketgan
Zavod direktoridan kechagi ishlarini so'rab biladi
scenarios.hint: Kosmik multispektral suratlar daryodagi har qanday noqonuniy oqova izini aniq koordinatasi bilan xaritaga muhrlaydi.

scenarios.title: Dron Lazer Spektrometri (CH4 Metan Xaritasi)
scenarios.param: Dron parvozi: 50m balandlik | Lazer detektori: TDLAS
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><circle cx="180" cy="40" r="14" fill="#3b82f6"/><text x="180" y="45" fill="white" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle">🛸</text><path d="M 180 54 L 220 90 L 320 90 L 180 54" fill="#10b981" opacity="0.2"/><circle cx="270" cy="85" r="15" fill="#ef4444"/><text x="270" y="90" fill="white" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">500 ppm</text><text x="380" y="85" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="11" font-weight="bold">Metan Sizib Chiqish Nuqtasi</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Katta poligonda metan gazi qayerdan sizib chiqayotganini aniqlash uchun eng tezkor usul:
options: Dazgohlangan dron lazerli metan datchigi (TDLAS) orqali uchib, konsentratsiya xaritasini (ppm) tuzish
Poligon bo'ylab gugurt yoqib yurish
Chiqindilarni qo'lda hidlab ko'rish
scenarios.hint: Lazerli datchiklar bir necha santimetr aniqlikda metan sizayotgan yoriqlarni darhol topib beradi.

scenarios.title: Ko'p Yillik Xaritalar Solishtiruvi (Change Detection)
scenarios.param: 2020-yil sun'iy yo'ldosh xaritasi vs 2026-yil xaritasi
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="80" y="35" width="120" height="60" rx="8" fill="#1e293b"/><text x="140" y="60" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2020: 4 Gektar</text><text x="140" y="78" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Chegara bo'yicha</text><text x="240" y="70" fill="#ef4444" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">→</text><rect x="270" y="35" width="150" height="60" rx="8" fill="#7f1d1d" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2"/><text x="345" y="60" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2026: 11 Gektar!</text><text x="345" y="78" fill="white" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">+7 Ga Noqonuniy Egallangan</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Chiqindixona egasi chegara buzilmagan desa, kosmik arxiv suratlari qanday isbotlaydi?
options: O'tgan 5 yillik yuqori aniqlikdagi multispektral suratlarni ustma-ust qo'yib (Change Detection) noqonuniy kengaygan gektarlarni isbotlash
Eski qog'oz xaritaga qarab bahslashish
Chiqindixona egasining aytganiga ishonish
scenarios.hint: Sun'iy yo'ldosh arxivi o'chmas raqamli dalildir; yer maydonining yillar davomida qanday o'zgarganini sudga taqdim etadi.

scenarios.title: Tashlab Ketilgan Toksik Asbest Chiqindilari
scenarios.param: Tarkibi: Xrizotil asbest tolalari (O'pka saratoni omili)
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="180" y="30" width="140" height="70" rx="8" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Asbest Shiferlar</text><text x="250" y="75" fill="#f87171" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Kanserogen Tolalar</text><text x="250" y="90" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Spektral oqlik piki</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Eski tashlandiq binolar buzilganda asbest chiqindisi dashtga tashlab ketilgan. Qanday topiladi?
options: Asbest mineralining quyosh nuri ostidagi o'ziga xos ultra-oq spektral qaytarishi va datchiklar yordamida
U yerni haydab paxta ekib yuborish bilan
Asbestni qo'lda ushlab hidlab ko'rish bilan
scenarios.hint: Asbest tolalari shamolda uchib havoga tarqaladi; kosmik aniqlash zudlik bilan polimer germetik plyonkaga o'rash imkonini beradi.

scenarios.title: GIS Sanitar Qatlamlari va Aholi Maktablari
scenarios.param: Qonuniy talab: Chiqindixona maktabdan kamida 1000m uzoq bo'lishi shart
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><circle cx="200" cy="65" r="35" fill="#7f1d1d" opacity="0.3"/><circle cx="200" cy="65" r="10" fill="#ef4444"/><circle cx="310" cy="65" r="10" fill="#3b82f6"/><line x1="200" y1="65" x2="310" y2="65" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2"/><text x="255" y="55" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Masofa: 420m (Buzilish!)</text><text x="200" y="115" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">GIS Bufer Zonasi Tahlili</text></svg>
scenarios.question: GIS tizimida noqonuniy poligon maktabdan atigi 420 metr masofadaligi aniqlandi. Huquqiy qaror:
options: Sanitar qonunchilik qo'pol buzilganligi sababli chiqindixonani zudlik bilan to'xtatish va tozalab ko'chirish talabnomasi
Maktabni boshqa joyga ko'chirish
Hech qanday chora ko'rmaslik
scenarios.hint: GIS bufer zonalari (Buffer Analysis) qonuniy masofalar buzilganini millisekundlarda xaritada qizil rang bilan belgilab beradi.

scenarios.title: Yerosti Yonishi (Smoldering Fire) Xavfi
scenarios.param: Poligon chuqurligida havosiz yonish harorati: 140°C
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="150" y="30" width="200" height="70" rx="8" fill="#7f1d1d" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yerosti Yonishi: 140°C 🔥</text><text x="250" y="75" fill="white" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Termal infraqizil dron fosh etdi</text><text x="250" y="90" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">O'pirilish va zaharli gaz otilishi arafasida</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Ustidan qarab bilinmaydigan, ammo ichkarida 140°C da tutab yonayotgan poligon qanday qutqariladi?
options: Yonayotgan chuqurlikka azot (N2) gazi yoki suvli bentonit gil suspenziyasi haydab havo kirishini butunlay bo'g'ish
Chuqurlikka benzin quyish
Ustidan olov yoqib ko'rish
scenarios.hint: Yerosti yonishiga oddiy suv quyish bug' portlashiga olib keladi, faqat kislorod kirishini to'suvchi gilli bo'g'ish qo'llaniladi.

13.title: 13. Kompost Master: C/N Balansi
13.desc: Jigarrang (Uglerod) va Yashil (Azot) chiqindilarni 30:1 nisbatda qorishtirib bio-gumus oling.

scenarios.title: Ideal C:N Nisbati (30:1 Balansi)
scenarios.param: Jigarrang (Uglerod C): Somon, qipiq | Yashil (Azot N): Oziq-ovqat, go'ng
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="70" y="35" width="160" height="60" rx="6" fill="#78350f"/><text x="150" y="60" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">30 qism Uglerod (C)</text><text x="150" y="78" fill="#fef08a" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Quruq xazon / Somon</text><text x="250" y="70" fill="#10b981" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">:</text><rect x="270" y="35" width="160" height="60" rx="6" fill="#047857"/><text x="350" y="60" fill="#a7f3d0" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1 qism Azot (N)</text><text x="350" y="78" fill="white" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Oshxona chiqindisi</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Mikroorganizmlar tez va hidsiz bio-gumus hosil qilishi uchun C:N (Uglerod/Azot) nisbati qanday bo'lishi kerak?
options: Taxminan 25:1 dan 30:1 gacha — ya'ni 3 hissa quruq jigarrang materialga 1 hissa yangi yashil massa
1:100 qilib faqat go'sht tashlash kerak
Faqat polietilen paketlar aralashtirish kerak
scenarios.hint: 30:1 nisbatida bakteriyalar ugleroddan energiya oladi va azotdan o'z hujayra oqsilini quradi.

scenarios.title: Termofil Faza Harorati (55°C - 65°C)
scenarios.param: Uyum markazidagi harorat: 62°C | Patogenlar nobud bo'lmoqda
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><circle cx="250" cy="65" r="40" fill="#065f46" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="60" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">62°C</text><text x="250" y="80" fill="white" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Termofil Faza</text><text x="250" y="115" fill="#34d399" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Begona o't urug'lari va bakteriyalar zararsizlanadi</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Kompost uyumi ichidagi harorat nega 55-65°C gacha qizishi o'ta muhim?
options: Ushbu haroratda begona o't urug'lari, gelmint tuxumlari va kasallik qo'zg'atuvchi bakteriyalar 100% nobud bo'ladi
Chunki u yerda yong'in chiqishi kerak
Harorat oshishi kompostni buzadi
scenarios.hint: Sanitariya talabiga ko'ra kompost uyumi kamida 3 kun 55°C dan yuqori turishi toza o'g'it olishning kafolatidir.

scenarios.title: O'tkir Ammiak (NH3) Hidi Chiqishi
scenarios.param: Muammo: Uyumdan achchiq ammiak hidi kelmoqda | Sabab: Azot ko'p
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="170" y="30" width="160" height="70" rx="8" fill="#7f1d1d" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">NH3 Ammiak Hidi ⚠️</text><text x="250" y="75" fill="#ffffff" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Azot ortib ketgan (C/N past)</text><text x="250" y="90" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Zudlik bilan quruq somon/qipiq qo'shish!</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Kompost uyumidan o'tkir ammiak hidi kela boshladi. Bu nimadan darak beradi va nima qilish kerak?
options: Azot (yashil go'ng/oziq-ovqat) ko'payib ketgan; zudlik bilan quruq somon, qipiq yoki karton qo'shib aralashtirish kerak
Uyumga ko'proq go'sht va tuxum tashlash kerak
Uyum ustiga xlor sepish kerak
scenarios.hint: Uglerodli materiallar (qipiq, xazon) ortiqcha azotni bog'lab, qimmatbaho o'g'it elementlarini saqlab qoladi.

scenarios.title: Anaerob Chirindi va Vodorod Sulfid (H2S)
scenarios.param: Muammo: Chirigan tuxum hidi | Kislorod yetishmasligi (O2 < 5%)
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="160" y="30" width="180" height="70" rx="8" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Aeratsiya Yetishmaydi</text><text x="250" y="75" fill="#f87171" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Anaerob sharoit (Kislorodsiz)</text><text x="250" y="90" fill="#34d399" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Ushbu uyumni vilkalar bilan ag'darish shart</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Kompostdan sasigan tuxum hidi kelsa va ichi qorayib ketsa, bunga nima sabab bo'lgan?
options: Kislorod yetishmasligi sababli anaerob chirish boshlangan; uyumni zudlik bilan ag'darib havo berish (aeratsiya) kerak
Bakteriyalar juda ko'p kislorod olganidan
Uyumga juda ko'p quruq xazon solinganidan
scenarios.hint: Aerob bakteriyalar kislorod bor joyda hidsiz ishlaydi; havo yetishmasa sassiq anaerob gazlar ajraladi.

scenarios.title: Optimal Namlik Darajasi (50% - 60% Siqish Testi)
scenarios.param: Kaftda siqqanda: Suv tomchilamaydi, lekin nam quyuq sharcha bo'lib qoladi
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><circle cx="250" cy="65" r="35" fill="#0284c7" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="60" fill="white" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">55%</text><text x="250" y="78" fill="#e0f2fe" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Optimal Namlik</text><text x="250" y="115" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Siqqanda suv oqmasligi, ammo kaft nam bo'lishi kerak</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Kompostdagi namlik qanday tekshiriladi va ideal namlik qancha bo'lishi kerak?
options: Namlik 50-60% bo'lishi kerak (kaftda siqqanda suv tommasdan nam sharcha bo'lib turishi - siqilgan gubka kabi)
Quruq chang holatida 5% bo'lishi kerak
Suvda suzib yuradigan darajada 95% bo'lishi kerak
scenarios.hint: Namlik 40% dan tushsa bakteriyalar faoliyati to'xtaydi, 65% dan oshsa havo yo'llari suvga to'lib chirish boshlanadi.

scenarios.title: Vermikompost: Kaliforniya Qizil Chuvalchangi
scenarios.param: Harorat: 20°C - 25°C ga tushdi | Chuvalchanglar bio-gumus yaratmoqda
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="160" y="30" width="180" height="70" rx="8" fill="#065f46" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#34d399" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Eisenia Fetida Chuvalchangi</text><text x="250" y="75" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Koprolit (Toza Bio-Gumus)</text><text x="250" y="90" fill="#ffffff" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">O'sish stimulyatori va fermentlar</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Kompost uyumi sovigach (25°C) unga qizil chuvalchanglar solinsa nima sodir bo'ladi?
options: Chuvalchanglar organikani yeb eng yuqori sifatli fermentlarga boy 'Koprolit' (Bio-gumus) o'g'itiga aylantiradi
Chuvalchanglar kompostni zaharli qilib qo'yadi
Ular barcha organikani yo'q qilib tashlaydi
scenarios.hint: Vermikompost oddiy kompostdan 4-8 barobar unumdor bo'lib, o'simlik ildizini barcha kasalliklardan asraydi.

scenarios.title: Go'sht va Sut Mahsulotlarini Cheklash
scenarios.param: Ochiq kompost uyumiga yog'li go'sht va pishloq tashlash mumkinmi?
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><circle cx="150" cy="65" r="25" fill="#7f1d1d" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2"/><text x="150" y="65" fill="white" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">🥩 ✕</text><text x="320" y="60" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Ochiq kompostga go'sht taqiqlanadi!</text><text x="320" y="80" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Kalamush, chivin va zaharli chirishni chaqiradi</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Nega ochiq bog' kompostiga yog'li go'sht, baliq va sut qoldiqlari solish tavsiya etilmaydi?
options: Yog'lar havo kirishini to'sib chirindi hid chiqaradi va kemiruvchilar (kalamushlar) hamda chivinlarni jalb qiladi
Chunki go'sht hech qachon chirimaydi
Chunki u o'g'itni qora rangga bo'yab qo'yadi
scenarios.hint: Hayvon yog'lari va go'sht faqat maxsus yopiq Bokashi fermentatorlarida yoki biogaz reaktorlarida utilizatsiya qilinadi.

scenarios.title: Kompost Uyumi Minimal O'lchami (1m x 1m x 1m)
scenarios.param: Hajm: 1 metr kub (minimal kritik massa)
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="190" y="30" width="120" height="70" rx="8" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#34d399" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1 m³ Hajm</text><text x="250" y="75" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Issiqlikni saqlovchi massa</text><text x="250" y="90" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="8" text-anchor="middle">Kichik uyumlar tez sovib qoladi</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Kompost uyumi nega 1 metr kubdan kichik bo'lmasligi kerak?
options: Kichik uyumlar hosil bo'lgan biologik issiqlikni saqlay olmaydi va tez sovib, termofil bosqichga chiqa olmaydi
Chunki qonunda kichik uyumlar taqiqlangan
Chunki kichik uyumga chuvalchang sig'maydi
scenarios.hint: 1 m x 1 m x 1 m o'lchami tashqi sovuq havoga qaramay markazda 60°C issiqlikni saqlash uchun ideal termal massadir.

scenarios.title: Yetilgan Bio-Gumus Sifatini Tekshirish (Solvita Testi)
scenarios.param: Rangi: Qoramtir-jigarrang | Hidi: Nam o'rmon tuprog'i hidi
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="150" y="30" width="200" height="70" rx="8" fill="#047857" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#34d399" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yetilgan Qora Oltin (Gumus)</text><text x="250" y="75" fill="white" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Yomg'irdan keyingi toza o'rmon hidi</text><text x="250" y="90" fill="#a7f3d0" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Solvita Index = 8 (Barqaror)</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Kompostning to'liq yetilganini va o'simlik ildizini kuydirmasligini qanday bilish mumkin?
options: Uyum to'liq sovigan, rangi qora-jigarrang bir jinsli bo'lib, xushbo'y yangi o'rmon tuprog'i hidi keladi
Uyumdan kuchli achchiq tutun chiqib tursa
Uyumda hali butun pomidor va kartoshkalar ko'rinib tursa
scenarios.hint: Chala pishgan kompost o'simlik ildizidagi kislorodni tortib oladi, faqat to'liq yetilgan gumus o'simlikni oziqlantiradi.

scenarios.title: Xomashyoni Maydalashning (Shredding) Samarasi
scenarios.param: Fraksiya: 2-5 sm gacha maydalash | Tezlik: 3 barobar tez
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="80" y="40" width="130" height="50" rx="6" fill="#334155"/><text x="145" y="65" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Yirik shox-shabba (2 yil)</text><text x="245" y="70" fill="#10b981" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">→</text><rect x="275" y="40" width="150" height="50" rx="6" fill="#065f46" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="350" y="62" fill="#34d399" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2-5 sm Shreder (2 oy)</text><text x="350" y="78" fill="#a7f3d0" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">6 barobar tezroq chirish</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Qalin daraxt shoxlari va poyalarni maydalab kompostga solish nimasi bilan foydali?
options: Bakteriyalar uchun aloqa yuzasi yuzlab barobarga oshadi va kompostlash vaqti 2 yildan 2-3 oyga qisqaradi
Chunki maydalanmagan shoxlar kompost idishini teshadi
Faqat tashish oson bo'lishi uchun
scenarios.hint: Shrederdan o'tgan mayda fraksiya namlik va issiqlikni bir tekis taqsimlab, fermentatsiyani maksimal tezlashtiradi.
